releaseNotes:
SAM 0.12.22 fixes a false-positive in New software detection and redesigns the Tray's My support cases view.

- Software installed via winget's MSIX fallback (e.g. Store-updated apps) no longer reads as a brand-new install on every silent update — the Agent now tracks a stable per-app ID instead of one that embedded the exact version number.
- The registry's own install date is now used as a cross-check against when we first detected an app.
- My support cases is redesigned as a compact two-pane list, with a mail-status line per case, click-to-expand detail, and an unread-count badge on the tray icon.
